svg.aria-label: Recall by category for three models. Unweighted DistilBERT labels every excerpt as technical help (100% recall there, 0% elsewhere). Class-weighted DistilBERT swings the other way: 14% on technical help, 83% on opinion. TF-IDF with logistic regression is more even, between 22% and 51% in every category.
